article_title: Adidas sues Australian label White Fox over four stripes design

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: White Fox is buying Adidas stores in Australia.
Adidas is suing White Fox over clothing designs with four stripes that it says resemble its trademark.
Australian courts have banned all advertising by fashion influencers.
Adidas is launching a new four-stripe logo for younger shoppers.
tasks.correct_answer: Adidas is suing White Fox over clothing designs with four stripes that it says resemble its trademark.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בתביעה של Adidas נגד White Fox בטענה שעיצוב ארבעת הפסים דומה באופן מטעה לסימן המסחר שלה.

tasks.prompt: Since when does Adidas say it has repeatedly asked White Fox to stop selling and promoting the disputed clothes?
options: Since 2013
Since June 2025
Since March
Since Friday
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי Adidas, החברה ביקשה שוב ושוב מ־White Fox להפסיק את המכירה והפרסום מאז חודש מרץ.

tasks.prompt: In the phrase “deceptively similar”, what does “deceptively” suggest?
options: The designs are made in different countries.
The similarity is easy for every buyer to ignore.
The products are sold only online.
The similarity could mislead people into thinking the brands are connected.
tasks.correct_answer: The similarity could mislead people into thinking the brands are connected.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: deceptively מציין דמיון שעלול להטעות צרכנים ולגרום להם לחשוב שיש קשר או אישור בין המותגים.

tasks.prompt: What feature of the White Fox design does Adidas describe in its court documents?
options: Four parallel stripes of equal width
Three curved stripes of different colours
A single stripe across each sleeve
Five stripes placed only on shoes
tasks.correct_answer: Four parallel stripes of equal width
tasks.explanation_hebrew: במסמכי בית המשפט Adidas מתארת בגדים עם ארבעה פסים מקבילים וברוחב שווה.

tasks.prompt: Why does Adidas mention advertisements showing White Fox products together with genuine Adidas items?
options: To prove White Fox sells only sports shoes
To show that Adidas supplied the clothes to White Fox
To argue that consumers might assume Adidas approved or is associated with White Fox
To explain why White Fox's prices increased
tasks.correct_answer: To argue that consumers might assume Adidas approved or is associated with White Fox
tasks.explanation_hebrew: השילוב של פריטי White Fox עם מוצרים מקוריים של Adidas עשוי ליצור אצל צרכנים רושם מוטעה של קשר או אישור.

tasks.prompt: What does “infringement” mean in the article's legal context?
options: A successful advertising campaign
A violation of a legal right such as a trademark
A reduction in company revenue
A private agreement between two brands
tasks.correct_answer: A violation of a legal right such as a trademark
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר המשפטי infringement פירושו הפרה של זכות חוקית, כאן סימן המסחר של Adidas.

tasks.prompt: What changes does Adidas allege were made to the online image of White Fox socks after court proceedings began?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שבתחילה הוסר דיגיטלית פס אחד מנעלי Adidas הוורודות, ובהמשך נמחקו מהתמונה כל שלושת הפסים.
expected_points: The model in the listing was wearing pink Adidas shoes.
A few days after proceedings were lodged, one stripe was digitally removed from the shoes.
About a week later, all three Adidas stripes were removed from the image.

tasks.prompt: Summarise Adidas's case against White Fox and the remedy it is seeking.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול את הדמיון הנטען בין ארבעת הפסים לסימן המסחר, החשש להטעיית צרכנים, הראיות בפרסומות, והדרישה לרווחים, ריבית והוצאות.
expected_points: Adidas says White Fox's four equal parallel stripes are substantially identical or deceptively similar to its trademark.
It argues the advertising may make consumers believe the companies are associated or that Adidas approved the design.
Adidas submitted product comparisons and advertising images as evidence.
It seeks damages including profits from the disputed products, interest and costs.

tasks.prompt: Why could Adidas's long trademark history and reputation in Australia strengthen its claim?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שסימן מוכר ורשום מאז 1957 קל יותר לקשר ל־Adidas, ולכן עיצוב דומה עלול לנצל את המוניטין ולבלבל צרכנים.
expected_points: Adidas says the three-stripe mark has been registered in Australia since 1957.
A well-known mark is more likely to be recognised by consumers.
A similar design could benefit from Adidas's established reputation.
Consumer recognition could support the claim that the four stripes create a misleading association.

tasks.prompt: Write a short neutral news brief explaining the dispute without deciding which company is right.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג את טענת Adidas, את העובדה ש־White Fox סירבה להפסיק את המכירה, את מועד הדיון ואת העובדה ששני הצדדים לא מסרו תגובה, בלי לקבוע אשמה.
expected_points: State that Adidas has filed a trademark case over White Fox's four-stripe clothing.
Describe Adidas's allegation that the design may mislead consumers.
Mention that White Fox did not stop selling the products after requests from Adidas.
Note that the first hearing is due on Friday and both law firms declined to comment.
